summary: Architectural and implementation plan for the Fake Payment Screenshot & TID Verifier app tailored for shopkeepers and merchants, featuring on-device Error Level Analysis (ELA) forensics, multimodal OCR for Pakistani wallets/banks (EasyPaisa, JazzCash, NayaPay, SadaPay, Raast), real SMS inbox TID cross-matching, loud audio sirens and voice alerts, and Room local history logging.
